description: P3 coupling: the Bash wait-loop / self-match discipline is enforced by two coupled artifacts and BOTH must stay pinned. (1) The governance prose lives in plugin/governance/definitions.md (`the only sanctioned wait primitive`) and is referenced by plugin/agents/overlord.md (`Bash Command Discipline per `) -- pinned by the source/consumers block below. (2) The MECHANICAL backstop is CHECK 14 in tools/policy_check.sh, which lints every plugin/**/*.md for the prescribed hand-rolled wait-loop forms and self-matching `pgrep -f`. Without the set_check below, CHECK 14 could be deleted or weakened while every safety fixture still passes, silently making the mechanically-linted wait-loop forms regressable. The set_check pins the load-bearing literals that prove CHECK 14 exists, still emits CHECK14 findings, still self-exempts the definitions.md rule bullets, and still carries each of its three detection patterns: the `=== CHECK 14:` section header, `add_finding 'CHECK14'` (findings emission), the `the only sanctioned wait primitive|self-match` rule-anchor self-exemption constant, and the three regex probe tokens (pattern a `until ... pgrep`, pattern a2 `while|until ... pgrep|grep -q`, pattern b self-matching `pgrep -f`). superset mode fails if any is removed; extras elsewhere in the file are ignored.
